thread:
alice_sales: Heads-up — Acme asking for 7yr audit log retention + HSM KMS during the POC. They want a POC discount and an exception for long-term logs. Can we do a defined cap for the trial?

brian_se: Need details: are they storing full request payloads or metadata only? HSM is not cheap. We usually separate one-time setup vs recurring.

eve_cs: For reference, previous enterprise POC we did: 3mo, 30% off hosted usage, audit logs charged normally but capped for trial period. Suggest similar approach.

claire_fin: Numbers matter — suggest we propose a capped bill for audit logs for the first 90 days (e.g., $1k/mo) + reduced HSM rate during POC. Otherwise finance won't sign.

dana_legal: Legal flags: need to confirm KMS key ownership and key rotation responsibilities. Also check DPA language for 7yr retention (EU data export implications).

alice_sales: Proposed draft for quote (feel free to tweak):
```
- POC term: 3 months
- Hosted usage: 30% discount for duration of POC
- Audit logs: bill at $0.12/GB, capped at $1,000/month during POC
- Long-term retention (7yr): one-time ingest + $90/TB/mo after POC (option to pre-pay)
- HSM/KMS: $1,500/mo during POC, $2,000/mo standard
- HIPAA add-on: $500/mo (controls & attestation)
- SOC2 continuous: included in enterprise bundle, add $300/mo if standalone
```

brian_se: That looks reasonable. If they commit to 12 months post-POC, we can rebate setup and lock HSM at $1,500/mo. Need deal-desk approval for the discounted HSM.

claire_fin: Finance ok in principle if sales gets a written commit or SOW. We need commit language in quote (milestones + early termination terms).

deal-desk-bot: Request submitted: DD-7892 — Special pricing for Acme (HSM discount during POC + audit log cap). Estimated review 48-72 hours.

alice_sales: FYI I'll tell the customer: POC quote on our side, audit logs capped, HSM at promo rate during POC. Asking them to sign a simple SOW and 30-day notice for retention changes.

eve_cs: I'll pull the Zephyr SOW and attach relevant retention clauses to the quote.

dana_legal: I'll draft the KMS ownership clause and retention clause for 7yr option (including deletion/retention proof). Need to confirm: are they requesting server-side encrypted payloads in logs?

brian_se: They did say logs need to be searchable, so we probably keep metadata unencrypted for indexing and payloads encrypted. That affects cost.

alice_sales: Great — thanks team. Once DD-7892 is green, I'll send the formal quote and SOW. :thumbsup:

claire_fin: One more note — if they want HIPAA + 7yr retention, flag for legal to confirm any state-specific obligations.

dana_legal: Noted. I'll include a short checklist for customer to complete (data types, locations, controller/processor roles).

alice_sales: Perfect — looping @brian_se and @dana_legal for any last-minute blockers.

(attachment: link to draft pricing sheet — https://redwood.internal/pricing/drafts/acme-compliance-poc)
